title: RunPod API key (rpa_): one-property twin (prefix)
summary: 1 input is identical to a positive input except for one change: the prefix differs from the contracted prefix (another namespace or a near-identical spelling). rationale: A twin changes exactly one property, so the expected outcome differs from the positive for that one reason. Reporting the twin is a false alarm, and it shows that the changed property is part of what identifies the credential.
